newsitem.title: UK: Nat Express shares gain on Scotrail news.
newsitem.headline: Nat Express shares gain on Scotrail news.

text.p: Shares in National Express Plc, the bus operator, rose on Tuesday after yesterday's late announcement that it was the preferred bidder for the Scotrail franchise.
The stock was up by 23-1/2p at 579 by 0845 GMT.

"We don't know the terms yet, but the market is generally quite pleased that these contracts are being picked up," said one transport industry analyst. "The potential for these businesses to become quite attractive is good."
The Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) said it chose National Express as the preferred bidder for the franchise over FirstBus Plc, down 1p at 242-1/2.

The provisional franchise announcement, which came just days after Virgin Group was awarded the long-distance Intercity WestCoast franchise, means that only one out of the 25 rail franchises remains to be awarded.
